entry.title: Quick start: a simple Push · Legs · Pull, set up in ten minutes
entry.summary: From the first launch to the first logged set: a simple Push · Legs · Pull without periodization that suits most people, three days a week, set up as a free repeating plan in TrainingPlanner, and how it progresses from there.
